MARKETING AUTOMATION / RITTER

One bot.
A connected marketing journey.

Ritter’s Telegram bot connects social content, subscription checks, useful materials and analytics. A project with several linked workflows, rather than a single command.

Open the bot ↗

The route through the system.

01 / ENTRY

A social post

A visitor discovers the brand through content and opens the Telegram bot.

02 / NAVIGATION

Telegram menu

The menu guides the visitor to the available materials.

03 / CONDITION

Subscription check

The bot checks the subscription before granting access to the material.

04 / VALUE

Material delivery

The visitor receives the guide through an automated flow.

05 / DATA

Database and statistics

Data storage and statistics support the marketing workflow, including Google Sheets reporting.

Illustrated workflow — not a screenshot of a user conversation.

What makes up the project.

01

The challenge

Connect the journey from a social post to a useful material, reduce repetitive manual delivery and give the team a way to track activity.

02

Audience experience

A clear Telegram menu, a subscription condition and material delivery form a continuous user journey. The guide is part of the brand communication rather than a disconnected file.

03

Automation

The connected flow covers navigation, subscription checks and material delivery. Designing it requires attention to both the content and the transitions between steps.

04

Data and reporting

A database supports data storage. Social statistics and Google Sheets reporting bring the marketing information into a usable format. Internal records and real user data are excluded from this case.

05

Content and visual system

Social creatives introduce the topic; guides provide the value; the bot connects these parts of the funnel. A consistent visual language makes the journey recognisable.

06

Project scope

The work spans user flows, content preparation, Telegram interaction, data storage and analytics integration. The public case shows the functional structure; the working bot can be explored in Telegram.
